concepts.label: Material Discrepancy
concepts.definition: Any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.
concepts.quote: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

summary: A material discrepancy is defined as any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.
quote: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.

concepts.label: Material Discrepancy Explanation
concepts.definition: The requirement that an applicant explain material discrepancies among the application name, citizenship evidence name, and identity evidence name.
concepts.quote: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity (see 22 CFR 51.25).

quote: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity (see 22 CFR 51.25).

concepts.label: Documenting Material Name Changes
concepts.definition: Requirement to document material name discrepancies by submitting one or more acceptable documents.
concepts.quote: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section (see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C)).

scope_quotes: (see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C))
scope_text: Except for married names as provided in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).

choice_text: One or more of: (1) Court orders or decrees: (a) Name change orders, or (b) Divorce decrees; (2) Certificates of naturalization; (3) Marriage certificates; (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or (5) Documentation of customary usage.

concepts.label: Review of Name Change Evidence
concepts.definition: The requirement to review evidence of material name changes for signs of counterfeiting or alteration.
concepts.quote: NOTE: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration (see 8 FAM 201.1)

action_quote: must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration
action: review for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration

concepts.label: Use of Previous Name
concepts.definition: Prohibition on continuing to use a previous name after a material name change, unless explicitly authorized by the documentation.
concepts.quote: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name (see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names).

scope_quotes: unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name
scope_text: After a material name change, unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name.

summary: An applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits continuing to use that name.
quote: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name (see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names).

concepts.label: Evidence of Identity Requirement Possibility
concepts.definition: Descriptive possibility that evidence of identity might be required to establish the name that best identifies the applicant.
concepts.quote: Consequently, under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant

context_quotes: The applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity.
action_quote: might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant
summary: Because an applicant's name is an integral part of identity, under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant.
quote: The applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity. Consequently, under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant

concepts.label: Application Suspension for Outdated ID
concepts.definition: Requirement to suspend a DS-11 application and request acceptable ID in the new name when a material name change occurred more than one year prior and ID is not updated.
concepts.quote: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.

concepts.label: Limited-Validity Passport Issuance
concepts.definition: Permission to issue a limited-validity passport in the requested name when urgent/emergency travel does not allow sufficient time to obtain updated ID.
concepts.quote: If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name;

concepts.label: Name Change Documentation for ID Update
concepts.definition: General necessity of name change documentation for an applicant to update ID.
concepts.quote: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.

concepts.label: Notation of Name Change Documentation
concepts.definition: Requirement to fully notate name change documentation as 'seen and returned' before returning it with an IRL.
concepts.quote: You must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL);

concepts.label: Exemption from Submitting ID in New Name
concepts.definition: Exemption for applicants with a recent material name change from submitting identification in the new name.
concepts.quote: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name.

concepts.definition: Requirement to submit name change documentation if ID has not yet been changed following a material name change within one year of application.
concepts.quote: However, if the ID has not yet been changed, they must submit their name change documentation.
